name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: The user aims to accurately record and monitor various physical activities, both automatically and manually, to maintain a complete log of their exercise habits.
The user seeks clear and insightful visualizations of their fitness data to easily track progress, identify trends, and stay motivated through achievement notifications.
The user desires the ability to define, customize, and track specific fitness goals to provide direction and maintain focus on their personal fitness journey.
The user expects to receive personalized workout recommendations that adapt to their fitness level and preferences, helping them optimize their training and achieve desired outcomes.
The user wants to effortlessly connect their wearable devices to the application for automatic, real-time syncing of fitness data, ensuring up-to-date and accurate information.
The user aims to share their fitness achievements and activities on social media to engage with their network, celebrate milestones, and foster a sense of community and motivation.
The wearable device's goal is to reliably collect and transmit fitness data (e.g., heart rate, steps, calories) to the application automatically and in real-time.
The wearable device aims to establish and maintain a stable connection with the fitness application to ensure consistent and uninterrupted data synchronization.
lowLevelGoals: The user can start an automatic tracking session for a chosen activity.
The user can add details of an activity they performed without automatic tracking.
The user can modify existing activity logs.
The user can see a consolidated view of their activities for a given day.
The user can visualize their activity patterns over time.
The user gets alerted for significant achievements.
The user can access in-depth data for individual activities.
The user can define a new objective for their fitness journey.
The user can adjust their current fitness objectives.
The user can easily see how close they are to achieving their goals.
The user gets alerted upon successful completion of a goal.
The user can ask for a tailored exercise regimen.
The user can rate or comment on workouts to improve personalization.
The user can explore various exercises with guidance.
The user can pair a new fitness tracker with the app.
The user can check if their devices are currently connected.
The user can force a data sync if needed.
The user can post their workout results to their social network.
The user can control who sees their shared fitness data.
The user can interact with their social network regarding their fitness posts.
The user can post specific achievements with visual flair to their social network.
The device gathers fundamental movement and physiological data.
The device converts raw data into understandable fitness information.
The device sends updated fitness information to the app without user intervention.
The device can save data when offline to prevent loss.
The device initiates a secure wireless link with the app.
The device attempts to reconnect to the app after a disconnection.
The device informs the app about its current connection state.
